name: Carl Jonas Love Almqvist
credit: Portrait of C. J. L. Almqvist, Nationalmuseum, Stockholm · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: Carl Jonas Love Almqvist (1793–1866) was a Swedish Romantic writer, schoolman and reformer, born in Stockholm. He worked as a civil servant and schoolmaster, took holy orders, and for many years issued his collected imaginative writings under the title Törnrosens bok (The Book of the Briar Rose, 1832–51), a vast miscellany of tales, plays, essays and verse.

His short lyrics were gathered as Songes, small songs with music that he composed himself, among them the well-loved Hjärtats blomma. In 1851 he was accused of fraud and an attempted poisoning and fled Sweden, living in the United States and later in Germany, where he died in Bremen in 1866.

poems.title: Hjärtats blomma
poems.author: Carl Jonas Love Almqvist
poems.text:
En blomma står i hjärtats hem,
hon har ingen färg ännu;
Herren Gud i himmelen
den blomman har gjort, o Du! -
Blomman stod i hjärtats hem,
hon hade ej färg ännu,
men av Herren Gud dock hon hade namnet Törnros.

Rosens törnen såra hjärtat.
Då rinner blod därur.
Hjärtat frågar Herren:
"Hvi gav du den rosen åt mig?"
Herren himmelskt svarar:
"Blodet utur ditt hjärta färgar din ros åt dig:
du och ditt hjärtas ros då likna i fägring mig."
